reason: 该插件的主要用途是向agent提供一个本地技能索引的列表与检索接口：通过 list_skills 获取全部条目，通过 search_skills 按关键词在名称/描述中匹配并返回结果，依据 readme 和包清单可确认其能力仅为索引读取与查询。

summaries.zh: 这是一个DSH插件，提供对内置技能索引的按名/描述检索与列表能力，让agent可快速找到可复用技能定义。
summaries.en: This DSH plugin provides listing and keyword search over a bundled skill index so an agent can quickly find reusable skill definitions.

capabilities: Registers two DSH tools: list_skills and search_skills.
list_skills returns bundled skill name/description entries.
search_skills performs case-insensitive matching over skill name and description with optional result limiting.

reasons.code: README specifies plugin exposes only two read/query tools for the in-repo skill index
Package exports bundled static data files and uses a patch-based DSH bundle with no runtime build step
Repository metadata indicates public, active, immutable commit and passes admission checks
